description: Returns a single project by projectId with every saved post, newest first: postId, platform, creator handle, post link, thumbnail, title, a caption excerpt, content type, posting date, views, likes, comments, engagement rate, all-time outlier score, the note the user wrote when saving it, and whether the platform has since removed the post. Up to 500 posts (truncated says when there are more). Free to call. Pass a postId to request_transcript, request_visual_analysis or remix_post. Cost: free.
name: get_project
title: Get a Project and Its Saved Posts
